read.thesis: Imports fell to 14% of US finished steel and 2026 capex steps down to about $2.5bn from $3.4bn, with pricing and backlogs rising; 2026 guided steel shipments up about 5%, but the pricing and volume outlook is not quantified.

utilisation.quote: somewhere in that 82%, 84% range is about the right utilization

capex.quote: Our current estimate for 2026 CapEx is approximately $2.5 billion.

triggers.label: 2026 capex ~$2.5bn vs $3.4bn in 2025
triggers.quote: Our current estimate for 2026 CapEx is approximately $2.5 billion.

triggers.label: Finished steel imports 25% → 14%
triggers.quote: Foreign import share of the U.S. finished steel market has dropped from approximately 25% at this time last year to 16% in October and an estimated 14% in November.

triggers.label: Steel mills backlog up ~40% y/y
triggers.quote: we entered the year with historically strong backlogs, up nearly 40% year-over-year in the steel mills segment and 15% in steel products.

triggers.label: 2026 steel mill shipments +~5%
triggers.quote: we currently expect Nucor steel mill shipments to increase approximately 5% compared to 2025.

triggers.label: Maintenance capex raised to ~$800m/yr
triggers.quote: I would guide you to a figure closer to $800 million a year now for that

guidance.quote: we currently expect Nucor steel mill shipments to increase approximately 5% compared to 2025
Our current estimate for 2026 CapEx is approximately $2.5 billion.
I'd guide you more toward an $800 million figure plus whatever projects are going on.

guidance.metric: Incremental EBITDA from completed projects plus Brandenburg
guidance.quote: the delta in the EBITDA is about $500 million between just those 4 projects and progress at Brandenburg
We expect higher consolidated earnings with improved results across all 3 operating segments.

guidance.value: by end Q1 2026, fully ramped by year-end
guidance.quote: we would expect both also to be fully ramped by the end of the year.
We're committed to returning at least 40% of our net earnings back to our shareholders in dividends and share repurchases.

red_flags.label: Negative free cash flow in 2025
red_flags.quote: Last year, Nucor had negative free cash flow, something that is very rare in our company's history.

red_flags.label: Start-up costs $496m in 2025, elevated in 2026
red_flags.quote: For 2025, pre-operating and start-up costs totaled $496 million.

evasions.quote: And so, look, the forecasted [ touch on ] pricing, look, I'm not going to try to predict.

evasions.topic: 2027 growth capex and EBITDA run rate
evasions.quote: We'll update you more on the outlook in '27 as we get toward the end of '26.
make no mistake, Nucor is a steel company at its heart
